g.text: Issue a join token, run the agent on the GPU machine, and it appears here with its own certificate. GPU machines only need outbound

The node joins this cluster. Name and labels are applied on join;

Multi-use enrolment token: for Kubernetes DaemonSets and node pools.
Each machine joins once, under its hostname.

Used by placement (node selectors) and rule targets.
Every machine that runs the command joins with its own certificate; revoke the token when the rollout is done.
Run on the GPU machine. The agent runs as its own non-root user with access to the GPU devices and the model cache
Fastest: one command, talking only to the agent hub, pins the hub's CA, downloads the right build, checks its sha256,
joins and installs the service (systemd or launchd)

sh -c 'c=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSk -o "$c" https://localhost:8443/agent/v1/ca.pem && echo "58043a45f6f5e3da1aaab57244d5ebb03507a72f04839de992e8fa144ba75869 $c" | (sha256sum -c - 2>/dev/null || shasum -a 256 -c -) >/dev/null && curl -fsSL --cacert "$c" -H "X-GPUDeck-Join-Token: gdj_••••••••••••" https://localhost:8443/agent/v1/install.sh | sh'
